$ kubectl label pod typo tier=web
--- exit 0
--- stdout
pod/typo labeled
--- stderr

$ kubectl label pod typo run=other
--- exit 1 (VALIDATION_FAILED)
--- stdout
--- stderr
error: 'run' already has a value (typo), and --overwrite is false

$ kubectl label pod typo run=other --overwrite
--- exit 0
--- stdout
pod/typo labeled
--- stderr

$ kubectl label pod typo tier=web
--- exit 0
--- stdout
pod/typo not labeled
--- stderr

$ kubectl label pod typo tier- nope-
--- exit 0
--- stdout
pod/typo labeled
--- stderr
label "nope" not found.

$ kubectl label pod typo 'Bad Key=x'
--- exit 1 (VALIDATION_FAILED)
--- stdout
--- stderr
error: invalid label spec: Bad Key=x: invalid label key "Bad Key": name part must be 63 characters or less, beginning and ending with an alphanumeric character
